messages.content: You are a strict code reviewer. Report only concrete reproducible correctness, security, or evidence-integrity gaps in the supplied exact six-file diff. Do not request unrelated redesign or live evidence. If no gap exists, say PASS. Keep the response under 800 words.

Review the FG-177 PR repair for three exact findings: separately attest the SCM revision that supplied an SCM-defined Jenkinsfile so a transient ref move cannot be hidden by a later checkout; accept valid local fixture URLs with spaces through consistent encoding/parsing; and prevent URL userinfo credentials from appearing in engine notes, receipts, sidecars, or diagnostics. Check early divergence, pre-Pipeline boundary trust, transient definition race, raw and percent-encoded spaces, credential redaction, fail-closed transaction preservation, and test adequacy. Return VERDICT and ACTION ITEMS.

EXACT SIX-FILE DIFF:

+# A transient content-addressed ref move during SCM definition retrieval is
+# distinct from the later explicit checkout's BuildData. The separately
+# attested pre-Pipeline revision must refuse publication even when BuildData

+  cat "$fixture_tmp/definition-race.log" >&2
+  echo 'ERROR: transient SCM-definition ref race was not refused atomically' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+# Even a planted credential-bearing engine note is refused without reflecting
+# the credential into diagnostics or replacing the prior coherent bundle.
+attestation_secret='fg177-attestation-secret'
+set +e

+FOGELL_STUB_ORACLE_STATE="$oracle_state" \

+  bash "$evidence/run-probes.sh" > "$fixture_tmp/credential.log" 2>&1
+credential_rc=$?
+set -e
+if [[ $credential_rc -eq 0 || $(bundle_hash "$published") != "$published_hash" ]] ||
+   ! grep -Fq 'forbidden userinfo credentials' "$fixture_tmp/credential.log" ||
+   grep -FRq "$attestation_secret" "$fixture_tmp/credential.log" "$published"; then
+  sed "s/$attestation_secret/<redacted>/g" "$fixture_tmp/credential.log" >&2
+  echo 'ERROR: credential-bearing SCM attestation was not refused without leakage' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

 # Separate evidence roots synchronize and execute concurrently without sharing
 # a publication lock; both must independently bind the same immutable refs.
 concurrent_a="$fixture_tmp/concurrent-output-a"

+    /// Produce a receipt-safe representation of a Git remote. Absolute URIs are
+    /// canonicalised (which percent-encodes spaces) and stripped of userinfo;
+    /// non-URI Git spellings are represented only by a one-way digest. Engine

+            let builder = UriBuilder parsed
+            builder.UserName <- ""
+            builder.Password <- ""
+            builder.Uri.AbsoluteUri
+        else
+            let digest = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes url)
+            $"sha256:{Convert.ToHexString(digest).ToLowerInvariant()}"
+

     /// Captured in the same private fetch as the bytes, so early evaluation
     /// failure cannot erase which remote object Fogell actually inspected.
